title: Sensitive, high-impact use where the context itself is not established
pins: An unknown dimension and a conflicting one both make the inputs they feed unknown, and unknown levels never read as low: they keep every scope incomplete.
A context past its valid_until counts as unconfirmed however it was confirmed before, and a pass resting on expired evidence becomes a material unknown rather than staying a pass.
Inferred answers are usable but visible: they appear as assumptions on every derived risk and hold confidence down.

application.name: CareNotes
application.description: Note-taking app used by a care provider's staff, with a pending decision to open it to client families.

data_summary: Care notes about identifiable people. Whether they include health details is exactly what nobody has confirmed yet.
assumptions: The reviewer could not reach the data controller before this revision; the sensitive-data question is open.

network_exposure.rationale: The deploy target is a public platform URL with no listing or index, but nobody confirmed whether the address is shared beyond the staff.

authentication.rationale: Signup is disabled in the exported settings; whether invitations are restricted in practice is unconfirmed.

data_sensitivity.rationale: The care notes may contain health information. The data controller has not answered, and guessing the benign answer here would be the whole mistake this model exists to prevent.

financial_operations.rationale: The founder says the app never charges anyone; the repository contains a live payment integration with a configured price. Unresolved.

findings.rationale: A staff account could open another staff member's client note by changing the record id in the URL; reproduced twice.

evidence.scope: Account B read one known record owned by account A in public.notes. Decisive for that record; it is not proof for other tables or operations.

findings.rationale: Full note bodies are sent to a third-party model provider and written to the request log, with no redaction step.

evidence.scope: Current working tree only, rulesets llm.prompt_pii and obs.log_pii. Matches in api/summarize.js and lib/logger.js.

findings.rationale: The inbound webhook verified signatures and timestamps when it was reviewed in April; nothing has re-verified it since.

evidence.scope: The handler as it stood on 1 April 2026, read end to end with the developer.
